name: model-tools
description: Classify files and texts with decision models and generate or edit images, through the API your Claude Code is configured for.

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from ~/.claude/settings.json (only when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL there points to a custom API host).

base_url.title: API URL (optional)
base_url.description: Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL from ~/.claude/settings.json.
